scope: R3 frozen revision2 six formal models; seed42 development Tune; no independent confirmation; endpoint primary,own-task best-screen secondary

sampling.evidence: M0 versus D2 BA3+0.3833pp, but mu recall-4.080pp and sparse mu-14.816pp; no tau gain. Complete paired results and unchanged quality guards fail adoption.

local_retention.evidence: Fixed-weight phase sensitivity exists, but independently trained stride2 versus D2 BA3-0.0333pp[-0.3657,+0.3533], electron recall-1.430pp. More dense compute does not recover useful common-task quality in this recipe.

native_relations.strong_reference_evidence: Native control and relations BA3 are0.9233/0.9467pp below same100k4pass B1 D0; no-global is1.3967pp below D0. Cross-family comparisons change representation and capacity.
native_relations.interpretation: No adopted relation gain. Removing the inter-block global stack lowers common BA3 by0.450pp and mu recall by1.370pp in this trained native recipe. The removal also changes capacity; no universal geometry or pure interaction conclusion.

information_available_used_useful.readability: Independent scaler and multinomial logistic C1 fitted on balanced Train4k only; each model reforwarded on full Tune40k. Local/regional/global/tracker probe quality is a property of these pooled features and readout, not an information upper bound or incremental utility.

information_available_used_useful.training_use: All six formal models pass actual optimizer health. Native control/relations/no-global have52 sampled windows each; relation gate/message/norm each have52 positive-gradient and52 positive-update windows.
information_available_used_useful.usefulness: The actual retrained ablation lowers all-Tune BA/NLL quality; sparse electron/muon redistribution gives no net BA/AP/AUROC gain. Positive gradient or readable features alone does not satisfy promotion.

seed_resolution_anchor_fusion.next: R4 candidate/robust-fit quality and observation-only object features first; revisit anchors/fusion only after coverage and complementary discrimination are measured.

compact_sensor_rows.evidence: C1 versus D0 BA3+0.1367pp[-0.2134,+0.5036], electron recall-3.420pp. Same-device Train10k/1024-update profile gives2.7230x train throughput and1.7469x operation throughput; five-fold bias does not recover class quality.

selected_models.task_decision: Deliver the trained T3 baseline and retain four-class research. Existing R2 matched T3/T4 task evidence does not show a stable common-task benefit from discarding tau; no flat fine-label expansion without valid conditional labels and inclusive gains.

remaining_limits: Development Tune is repeatedly used; none of these comparisons is independent confirmation. Cal-A/Cut-B/Confirm payloads remain sealed.
R3 inference intervals condition on seed42 fitted models and actual device/precision paths; training-seed and training-pool variation are unmeasured.
No converged/global-optimum or adequate-capacity claim. Weak sparse discrimination persists; nominal phase sensitivity alone does not determine its cause.
The three native arms are not a full2x2. No capacity-matched or shuffled-edge mechanism experiment, resolution scan, anchors or branch-modulation gain has been measured.
Candidate graph audit uses first-contributor labels, not full particle ancestry or physical track reconstruction efficiency; object association/coverage must be established in R4.
The A100-to-H100 no-global reforward changes probabilities by up to0.003715 and preserves99.89% argmax. Frozen primary predictions and original evaluation remain the scientific source.
Actual GPU utilization and complete interactive allocation overhead remain unmeasured; heterogeneous device-hours are allocation accounting, not equal FLOPs.

conditional_decisions.policy: unchanged frozen v2 practical-effect and quality criteria; all four complete evaluation matrices and independent nine-metric interval reviews

matched_seeds.reason: No R3 primary intervention meets either scientific gate; native relations have essentially zero BA gain and lower tau efficiency, and no-global is inferior to its family reference. No candidate is selected for seeds17/2026.
matched_seeds.not_measured: R3 training-seed uncertainty remains unmeasured; seed42 results do not establish population equivalence.

resolution.reason: No best improved native candidate selected. Native/100um/1mm scan is deferred until a useful observation-only geometry/object representation is established.
resolution.not_measured: No R3 resolution performance or detector-resolution limit is claimed.

capacity_or_shuffled_relations.reason: Relations-control does not yield an adopted gain; no-global plus relations also fails. A capacity-matched or shuffled-edge mechanism control would not resolve an adopted improvement in this campaign.
capacity_or_shuffled_relations.identifiability_limit: Control,relations,no-global are three arms, not a full2x2. Removing the global stack changes capacity; no claim of pure relation/global interaction or universally harmful relation information.

anchors.reason: Modality-visible graph increases coverage but recorded same-track candidate recall remains limited. Test candidate association/robust fits with station geometry and uncertainty before introducing another event-level anchor module.
anchors.required_reentry: Train/Tune small-sample candidate recall and object efficiency/fake/coverage evidence, followed by frozen observation-only raw+object comparison.

late_fusion.reason: Retrained removal of the global stack reduces all-Tune BA3 by0.450pp versus relations and does not improve tau. No demonstrated net local-specialist gain requiring a new fusion fit in this campaign.
late_fusion.future_reentry: Object-level features with validated coverage and complementary discrimination may motivate raw+object late fusion in R4.

branch_competition.reason: All branches have actual gradients and updates; removing the global stack fails overall quality. Sparse electron/muon recall redistribution alone does not establish a remediable optimization-competition mechanism.
branch_competition.not_measured: No gradient-modulation or branch-dropout benefit has been measured; readability is not utility.

compact_quality_recovery.reason: C1 improves same-device train throughput2.723x and short operation throughput1.747x, but electron recall declines3.420pp. Existing fixed five-fold global-bias diagnostic leaves3.15pp relative electron loss. No evidence supports an immediate bias-only recovery or seed/resolution expansion.
compact_quality_recovery.future_reentry: Freeze one targeted representation/head recovery and a quality/noninferiority plus matched-cost contract before retraining; compare to strong B1 using all events and sparse per-class guards.

conditional_decisions.scope: All conditional branches explicitly decided for R3; R4-R7 remain future work, not completed experiments.
